steps.content: Dawn is approaching. The night sky is tinged with clear blue. The glare of city lights hides the stars, and also your gazes.
Sitting behind Angell, the howling wind fills your ears, forcing you to shout to talk with her.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You seem to have been to a lot of places.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not really, and it's all just for work. There are many outstanding adventurers in the MBCC, so I always get to hear interesting travel stories.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I see.

Just as she finishes her sentence, the motorcycle speeds through the shadows cast by towering buildings. The night sky is now overtaken by the rising sun, its dazzling light forcing you to shield your eyes.
We'll have some good weather today, a sudden thought pops into your head.
A moment later, Angell speaks up again from the front.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You want to bring me into your life, so... what is your life like?
This seems to be the first time she has asked something about you.
You give it some serious thought.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's... kinda like when I'm with you.
Your helmet is a bit big, and when you lean forward, it touches Angell's back. As you talk, it vibrates noticeably more than the engine's roar, though only you can feel it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Receive a mission, complete it, eat, sleep... then work overtime again and again...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Many people out there need help, way more than you can imagine. The daily missions can be exhausting, but we receive a lot of thanks, which can be quite embarrassing at times.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Every day you can sleep soundly without fearing someone might take your life. You can have sweet dreams, and might even find a bowl of hot red bean soup by your bed when you wake up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... we have to fight a lot as well, and occasionally we run into ridiculously strong enemies that are on par with dark web hitmen, but nothing I can't handle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I might not look strong, but I'm also working hard to protect those important to me.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: That's nice. It's a life that suits you.
She goes quiet for a long time, so long that you think the howling wind has swallowed your words.
Then you finally hear a response.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm good. This is fine.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: It's better we stay like this.
Stay like this... Does she mean speeding along on the bike, living together, or...
As you ponder the meaning of her words, the sounds of the engine and hostile growls come from behind.

steps.speaker: Gangster A
steps.content: Found them! It's that Chief! He's out!
steps.female_content: Found them! It's that Chief! She's out!

steps.speaker: Gangster B
steps.content: Hahaha, catch them!

options: Gangsters slipped through the MBCC's net?

steps.content: You're confused. They are after you, but the gangs involved have already been dealt with. Then who are these people? A force hidden behind the scenes? New enemies?
No, they're already within Angell's alert range. Why hasn't she...

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: They probably saw the message I sent.
Her voice isn't loud, but it's very clear. Your mind reels.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I posted a message on the dark web, saying: "The MBCC Chief is in my hands. The previous gig has expired. If you want him, come with your price."
steps.female_content: I posted a message on the dark web, saying: "The MBCC Chief is in my hands. The previous gig has expired. If you want her, come with your price."

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Just like I expected, within an hour, tons of sky-high offers came in, dead or alive.

options: When did you do that? Why?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Shocked? Because none of your spies on the dark web noticed this? Heh, of course...

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: On the dark web, top-tier orders, intelligence, and users are all hidden with top-level encryption. Even if you logged into my account, what you saw was only the surface of the dark web. You, your Bureau, and those so-called experts, are just newbies.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: The fact that you believe me shows how little you know about this side of the world.
You had thought about using the shackles as the last resort. But this sudden confession sends a wave of panic through you, slowing down your action.
In that brief moment, the bike skids to a sharp halt, and you almost get thrown off. Instinctively, you hold on tight to the driver, missing your chance to use the shackles.

It's difficult to think clearly at this moment. You only see Angell securing your arms around her waist while drawing her blade with her free hand. Her helmet hides her eyes, but you're certain she's looking at the pursuers.
Her actions contradict her words. At that moment, something she said flashes through your mind.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: It's fine. I always dream of something good when I'm asleep, dying in a beautiful dream actually sounds pretty nice.
You blurt out.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No, you don't care about their offers.

steps.content: She doesn't respond, but even more memories flash through your mind.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: And to be able to help someone, to send them back into the sunlight... feels good.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: So, thank you, ${PlayerName}, for letting me feel the warmth I haven't felt in a long time.
She draws out her blade, but aims the handle at your abdomen first, causing you a burst of pain. Before losing consciousness, you hear her last few words in a daze.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Thank you for sharing the sunlight with me, ${PlayerName}. But you see, those who're used to the sunlight can't see the shadows at their feet.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You won't get to take me away. You're the one who's in trouble. Take care of yourself.
That's right... you were panicking not because you feared her betrayal.
But because you realize she has already made a decision you can't change.
